test_title: PYST 29: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A dealer offers 25% discount on an item. He offers a further discount of 15% on cash payment. A customer paid Rs. 255 in cash. Find the marked price of the item.
solution:
**Given Data:**

First discount = 25%

Second discount = 15%

Final price = Rs. 255

**Concept:**

Marked Price = Final Price / (1 - First Discount/100) / (1 - Second Discount/100)

**Calculation:**

Marked Price = 255 / (1 - 25/100) / (1 - 15/100)

⇒ Marked Price = Rs. 400

**Therefore, the marked price of the item is Rs. 400.**
